tools.name: search_ai_models
tools.description: Search the SoftPerceptron directory of AI models, autonomous agents and token/credit products. Returns pricing, specs and provider for each match. Use this to answer questions like 'what AI models are available', 'cheapest model with a big context window', or 'which coding agents exist'.

tools.name: get_ai_model
tools.description: Get full details for one directory entry by id or common alias (e.g. 'claude', 'gpt', 'gemini'). Returns pricing, specs, provider and links.

tools.name: compare_ai_models
tools.description: Compare two directory entries side by side — pricing, context window, modality and what each is best for. Both must be the same kind (model vs model, agent vs agent).

tools.name: can_i_run_model
tools.description: Check whether a specific open-weight model fits on a specific GPU: VRAM required, whether it fits, how much headroom, which quantization to use, and an estimated decode speed in tokens/sec. Use for questions like 'can an RTX 4090 run Llama 70B'.

tools.name: list_local_models
tools.description: List the open-weight models supported by the VRAM/can-i-run calculator, with parameter counts and what each is good for.

tools.name: list_gpus
tools.description: List the GPUs supported by the VRAM calculator, with VRAM, memory bandwidth and power draw.
